an4.11:1.1: carato cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā byāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā
an4.11:1.2: tañca bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti
an4.11:1.3: carampi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyoti vuccati.
an4.11:2.1: ṭhitassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā byāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā
an4.11:2.2: tañca bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti
an4.11:2.3: ṭhitopi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyoti vuccati.

an4.11:5.1: carato cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā byāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā
